info.name: StyleSlot — Salon SaaS & Multi-Tenant Platform API
info.description: Complete Postman API Collection for StyleSlot Salon Management System. Includes authentication, super-admin platform administration, salon owner operations, staff & shift scheduling, dynamic calendar & closures, breaks, appointments & queue management, client WhatsApp channels, and public booking engine.

item.name: 1. Core & Health
item.description: System health checks, keep-alive endpoints, and uptime probes.

request.description: Responds in <1ms without hitting database. Ideal for UptimeRobot, load balancers, or Kubernetes probes.
Queries PostgreSQL to confirm DB connection and returns uptime status.

item.name: 2. Authentication & Admin Profile
item.description: Authentication, registration, JWT refresh, password reset, and admin profile updates.

request.description: Authenticate salon owner or super admin. Sets access token and tenant salon ID in collection variables.
Self-serve registration for new salon tenant.
Obtain new short-lived access token using valid refresh token.
Returns authenticated admin user profile, role, and associated salon information.
Updates personal name, recovery email, or phone of logged in administrator.
Change current admin password while authenticated.

item.name: Forgot Password - Step 1: Lookup by Mobile

request.description: Checks if mobile is registered with a salon.
Sends 6-digit OTP code to registered mobile or email.

item.name: Forgot Password - Step 3: Reset with OTP

request.description: Validates 6-digit OTP and updates password.
Revokes the current refresh token.
Revokes all active sessions and refresh tokens for this admin.

item.name: 5. Client Channels & Messaging
item.description: End-customer touchpoints: Public web booking portal, Meta WhatsApp webhook engine, and two-way staff chat.
